::: {#def-risk-difference}
#### Risk difference (also called the absolute risk reduction)

Let:

- $\risk_1$ be the [risk](#def-outcome-risk) of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome in group 1.
- $\risk_2$ be the risk of the same outcome in the [reference group](#def-reference-group), group 2.

The **risk difference**, also called the **absolute risk reduction**, of group 1 compared with group 2 is

$$\RD \eqdef \risk_1 - \risk_2 \in [-1, 1].$$

Source: @wikipedia_absolute_risk_reduction.
:::
